title: Wellness Membership Reduction on a Self-Pay Visit Package Reinstatement Fee
content:
**Membership desk Q&A — reinstating a package.**

**Does a Wellness Membership reduce the fee to reinstate a Self-Pay Visit Package?**
A patient whose Wellness Membership is active has the reinstatement fee — in the amount at which it is charged for this reinstatement — reduced by that membership's package discount percentage; a patient whose membership is frozen has it reduced by half that percentage; anyone else has no reduction.

**What does the percentage act on?**
On the reinstatement fee only, as a percentage of it; the reduction is not rounded on its own.

**Which membership statuses count?**

| Wellness Membership status | Reduction of the reinstatement fee |
|---|---|
| active | the membership's package discount percentage |
| frozen | half of that percentage |
| pending start, past due, pending cancellation or cancelled | none |
| no membership | none |

**Worked answers (hypothetical memberships, a fee charged at $35.00)**

- Active membership with a package discount of 10 percent: $35.00 reduced by 10 percent is $31.50.
- Frozen membership with a package discount of 10 percent: reduced by 5 percent, $33.25.
- Frozen membership with a package discount of 5 percent: reduced by 2.5 percent, $34.125, carried unrounded.
